title: Pretty and stinky
text: Pretty and stinky. It’s a really pretty product I used it for my wigs shelf to spice it up a bit. It came almost vacuum packed, when you open it it gives a plasticy, chemically unrecognizable smell, I aired it out for a few days and the smell went away.. so it’s pretty if you can deal with the stink
